item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence that Srettha’s government used Thai-backed militias, proxy fighters, or arms recipients for atrocities or destabilization. I also found no evidence that he had to accept responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct in the relevant period. The available record is one of restraint, monitoring, humanitarian coordination, and diplomatic engagement, not proxy-enabled violence.","evidence":[{"title":"ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Statement on the Escalation of Conflicts in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 18, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?menu=5d5bd3dc15e39c306002ab1c&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac","summary":"ASEAN, with Thailand as a member, called for immediate restraint, cessation of violence, and protection of civilians.
